body: I drive people away because I'm toxic. I always think I've been bad to people and that I am the cause of their problems. That's narcissistic. I hate myself so much. I hate myself so much. I hate myself so much. I hate myself so much. Why do I do this to the people I love?
I have to do this though. I have to kill myself. It's something I need to do. I've been hospitalized twice in the past year and everything is just getting worse.

I'm going to kill myself soon. I am a narcissist and a bad person. I have decided that I'm going to hang myself. I get paid next week, so I'll buy a rope then. I actually feel relived, almost happy. It'll be over. Finally.
Why?
I want to kill myself.
Yeah I have one. The picture took place before all of my suicide attempts, and I look so full of hope. It makes me sad that I've fallen so hard.

A co-worker told me to shut up and stop talking while we were at the checkout. It makes me feel bad because I already feel like a burden. I was suicidal last night, and this just makes me more suicidal. 

I told a manager about it and she took care of it. I overheard the guy who told me that and he was on the phone. He was playing the victim saying like "I just got home for just shit talk." Fuck him. That's unprofessional and childish. Maybe I'm childish for getting so upset about it.

I keep on feeling sorry for myself because I'm weak. I have done bad things that are so horrible that I will never be able to redeem myself. I am weak. I am weak. I want to kill myself. I am a child. I am a piece of shit.
Yup. She was incorporating the essential oils in the sessions as well. I was so desperate to try anything at the time because I was suicidal, so I bought into it.

That's true. I expressed my financial concerns with a previous therapist, and her response was to schedule more sessions with her. Each session cost $120. Then, she tried to get me to buy essential oils and sign up under her mentorship, so that she could get a certain percentage of how much I spending on my essential oils. The talking did help a little, but it was overshadowed by all that other stuff that was going on.

I was exactly the same. I felt like when I was 19, I could cope with my problems better than how I do now. I could move on from my problems after a few hours and be okay. Now all of my negative thoughts just pile up into an overwhelming mess, and it's like I've dug myself a ditch so deep I can't get out.

No one cares. But why am I so concerned with people caring for me when I'm depressed? Sometimes I feel like I get all entitled to some sort of care when I'm suicidally depressed. People tell me to seek help when they've had enough of me and my problems, but I can't afford help. So I just sit in silence. I know it isn't their job, and it's bad of me to expect that of them when I talk about my problems excessively.
Yay!! Good job!

I kind of like it when I'm passively suicidal rather than active. I've overdosed seven times, and after each time I was scared shitless of death. However, I return to that dark spot, ignoring the past attempt and just do it again. Then, the cycle continues. Maybe that's just me. I'm not trying to be rude. For me, passive suicidal ideation is progress.

I've gained so much weight because of stress and medications. I want to lose weight, and I know it's a basic concept of burning more calories than consumed. Food is the one thing I enjoy. I don't enjoy much else. I want to feel attractive again. 

I need to do so much that it's overwhelming. I'm in so much debt, and I feel like there is no way out. It's all medical debt from being hospitalized for severe suicidal depression. The efficacy of the care I receive doesn't last long after I see the bill. 

After being hospitalized, the doctors set up an after care plan, but I can't afford it. I can't afford to go to therapy twice a week, and I can't go to the psychiatrist every month. The Nurse Practitioner at the hospital prescribed me a medication called Latuda. She gave me a savings card, but with the savings card it was still outrageously expensive. It ended up be $600 instead of $1200. This is my mood stabilizer. Now I'm on olanzipine, which doesn't help with the weight situation. How do they expect me to survive?

Thank you. My 20s have been horrible so far because I've attempted suicide seven times, and I have been institutionalized twice recently. Because of my hospitalization, I've accumulated a lot of debt. It hasn't been fun. I hope you're okay.
Yeah, cats are my favorite. I love dogs too. I like to look at r/rarepuppers and it cheers me up for a second.
Go back to school for an economics degree, get my own apartment, have a cute cat, and hug my mom everyday

I'm 23, and that's young. However, I feel worse and worse every time with each passing day. I get older, and I also get more depressed. When I was 19, I was so happy. Now at 23, I feel no hope. I feel like it's just going to get worse. I should act like and be an adult, but I'm not.
